description: Call this tool to add a computed column and save the result to a NEW file; the source is never modified unless out_path points at it. Returns the new file path, the row count and a preview of the first rows.

decimals.description: Round numeric formula results to this many decimals. Default: the widest decimal count of the columns the formula reads, capped at 2 when they all hold 2 or fewer (money in, money out); otherwise no rounding beyond float cleanup

formula.description: Expression over the columns of each row, in the same expression language as sheet_query, e.g. "[Qty] * [Unit Price]" or '[Country] = "PL"'. Give either formula or values

name.description: Name of the new column. It must not already exist on the sheet

out_path.description: Output file; default <source>-plus-<column>.<same ext>. The source file is left untouched unless this points at it

path.description: Path to the source .xlsx/.xlsm/.xlsb/.ods/.csv/.tsv file (~ is expanded); it is never modified

sheet.description: Sheet name; default is the first sheet

values.description: Explicit values, one per data row, instead of a formula. Missing entries are left blank

name: sheet_add_column
title: Add a column
